package.name: buoy_detector_driver
package.description: Adapter node that converts buoy_interfaces/msg/BuoyRelativePosition (published by perception/buoy_detector) into bluerov_control_msgs/msg/BuoyDetection so that bluerov_control_bt_nodes's CheckBuoyDetected has a real publisher to subscribe to. Subscribe-and-republish only; does not perform coordinate transforms or actuate anything.
